newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Creditanstalt staff to protest Bank Austria bid.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt staff to protest Bank Austria bid.

text.p: The workers' council of Austrian sell-off candidate Creditanstalt on Thursday called on all employees of the bank to demonstrate against a possible takeover of the bank by arch-rival Bank Austria.
"Together with the employees we want to protest against this threatened elephant's marriage," Austrian news agency APA quoted the head of the workers' council Helmut Wasser.

The council called on the bank's Vienna-based employees to stage a protest meeting at Creditanstalt's headquarters on Friday. Wasser said he expected up to 3,000 of the group's 9,800 employees to take part.

Bank Austria, the country's biggest bank, unveiled an 11th hour bid for Creditanstalt on Thursday, rivalling the only known offer for the state's 70 percent stake in the bank by a group led by insurer EA-Generali.

The bank did not disclose details of its offer, but media reports said it had bid some 16 billion schillings for the 19.9 million voting shares in Creditanstalt. The latest tender for the bank closes on Monday. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
